description: This Java class defines a command for deleting a feature's properties on a specific thing in an IoT or device management context. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, accessing details like the feature ID and resource path, and handling serialization.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureProperties
classes.description: A command object representing an instruction to delete a feature's properties from a specific thing, including mechanisms for serialization and validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DeleteFeatureProperties command instance from ThingId, featureId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a DeleteFeatureProperties command.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the Thing ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the feature properties resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into a JSON object.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified Ditto headers.
